description: This PHP class defines LocationSearchFilterParams, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate search filter parameters related to locations within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for location name, city, and country code, with corresponding getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sort fields for location searches and sets a default sort field upon initialization.

classes.name: LocationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying location-related search filters, including fields for name, city, and country code, and handling sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 'location.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the location name filter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the location name filter.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the current value of the city filter.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the value of the city filter.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the current value of the country code filter.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the value of the country code filter.
